purpose: Account for the extra calibration-label exposure of a five-parameter G2 gate
shared_labels: The same independent source calibration SEDs for G2 and scalar controls; no network training on these labels
N1_control: One global temperature selected from0.5,1,2 by worst-domain source-calibration CE
N2_control: One fixed global physics coefficient selected from0,0.05,0.2,1 by worst-domain source-calibration CE
G2_validation: Compute per-domain source-validation CE and gate distribution without refitting or checkpoint selection
limitations: Extra calibration supervision is explicit. A learned gate is not credited with identical supervision to an uncalibrated N1.
